findings: All four complete independent audits are required; scientific qualification or useful-memory success is not required. Actual audit context/variant schemas and all prescribed raw-or-failed-plan evidence match the inventory checks.

Per-model file trees must exactly match authenticated audit manifests. Entire qualification, diagnostic and design trees additionally preserve audit histories, reports and the first audit CLI directory failure.
Execution evidence now binds each writer to its exact phase/condition summary path and distinct log path; the crossed-summary and duplicated-log corruption tests reject substitutions.
Frozen source/input hashes and exact reproduction commit are checked. Reports, design notes and the saved donor-equivalence checker are explicitly included.
Relative paths and all symlinks are rejected; deterministic gzip/tar metadata, sorted partitioning, per-member hash verification and the actual compressed asset-size guard are tested.
changes_after_initial_review: Only requested execution provenance guards and explicit reproduction inputs/tools/docs were added; no numerical source or frozen experiment changed.
